recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR-47385 follow-up source work is needed. Any cleanup of unrelated grammar should be handled only through a separate editorial decision.

The current Task StructureDefinition definition contains [[[Request]]], execution progress, and [Fulfillment/Execution](request.html#fulfillment), and the Task introduction narrative also links to request.html#fulfillment. OO minutes from 2024-10-08 corroborate the FHIR-47385 vote and wording. Zulip searches found no direct or conflicting discussion. reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already satisfies the Jira decision. The remaining pre-existing grammar in "related informations" was left untouched because it was not part of the accepted change and does not alter implementer understanding.
